message.content:
Here's a comprehensive list of Sherlock Holmes movies organized by era:

## Silent Films (1900–1929)
- *Sherlock Holmes Baffled* (1900)
- *Adventures of Sherlock Holmes; or, Held for Ransom* (1905)
- *Sherlock Holmes in the Great Murder Mystery* (1908)
- *Arsène Lupin contra Sherlock Holmes* (1910)
- *A Study in Scarlet* (1914)
- *The Valley of Fear* (1916)
- *Sherlock Holmes* (1916) – starring William Gillette
- *Sherlock Holmes* (1922) – starring John Barrymore

## Early Sound Films & British Series (1931–1937)
- *The Sleeping Cardinal* (1931)
- *The Speckled Band* (1931)
- *The Missing Rembrandt* (1932)
- *The Sign of Four: Sherlock Holmes' Greatest Case* (1932)
- *The Triumph of Sherlock Holmes* (1935)
- *Silver Blaze* (1937)

## The Basil Rathbone Series (1939–1946)
- *The Hound of the Baskervilles* (1939)
- *The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes* (1939)
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror* (1942)
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon* (1943)
- *Sherlock Holmes in Washington* (1943)
- *Sherlock Holmes Faces Death* (1943)
- *The Spider Woman* (1944)
- *The Scarlet Claw* (1944)
- *The Pearl of Death* (1944)
- *The House of Fear* (1945)
- *The Woman in Green* (1945)
- *Pursuit to Algiers* (1945)
- *Terror by Night* (1946)
- *Dressed to Kill* (1946)

## 1950s–1970s
- *The Hound of the Baskervilles* (1959) – starring Peter Cushing
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Deadly Necklace* (1962)
- *A Study in Terror* (1965)
- *The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes* (1970) – directed by Billy Wilder
- *The Hound of the Baskervilles* (1972)
- *The Adventure of Sherlock Holmes' Smarter Brother* (1975)
- *The Seven-Per-Cent Solution* (1976)
- *Sherlock Holmes in New York* (1976)
- *Murder by Decree* (1979)

## 1980s–1990s
- *Young Sherlock Holmes* (1985)
- *The Great Mouse Detective* (1986) – Disney animated film
- *Without a Clue* (1988) – comedy with Michael Caine
- *Hands of a Murderer* (1990)
- *The Crucifer of Blood* (1991)
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady* (1991)
- *Incident at Victoria Falls* (1992)
- *The Hound of London* (1993)
- *1994 Baker Street: Sherlock Holmes Returns* (1993)

## 2000s–2010s
- *The Hound of the Baskervilles* (2000) – Hallmark TV film
- *The Sign of Four* (2001) – Hallmark
- *The Royal Scandal* (2001) – Hallmark
- *The Case of the Whitechapel Vampire* (2002) – Hallmark
- *Sherlock: Case of Evil* (2002)
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Case of the Silk Stocking* (2004)
- ***Sherlock Holmes*** (2009) – Guy Ritchie film starring Robert Downey Jr.
- ***Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows*** (2011)
- *Mr. Holmes* (2015) – starring Ian McKellen
- *Sherlock: The Abominable Bride* (2016)

## 2020s–Present
- *Enola Holmes* (2020)
- *Enola Holmes 2* (2022)
- *Enola Holmes 3* (TBA)

---

**Note:** This list focuses on major theatrical releases and notable TV films. Sherlock Holmes is one of the most portrayed characters in film history, with well over 200 adaptations including numerous short films, TV series episodes, and international productions.

Sources:
1. https://bakerstreet.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Sherlock_Holmes_Adaptations:_Films
2. https://www.listchallenges.com/sherlock-holmes-movies
3. https://sherlockholmes.com/pages/sherlock-holmes-movies?srsltid=AfmBOoo808IvuyDvmxeArS7-wTH0ex-WHT9hcDzJ7Z0H50CC7EdqQm-v
4. https://www.imdb.com/list/ls066973103/
5. https://www.imdb.com/list/ls059932117/
